alternatives.reason: Stable5.4.2 supports Node>=20 and MIT, so not rejected on a main-README v6 Node24 statement. A second JS runtime/client scheduler would add an authority boundary when canonical commands are Python. Reconsider only if the actual owner identifies a consumer requiring that runtime.

Current bounded original Core renderer already escapes TEXT/folds UTF-8. Replacing runtime bytes without versioning risks persisted icsSha256 compatibility; test-oracle reuse is the proposed first increment.
